text: The phrase "with the intent to commit a felony therein" is the felonious-intent element of common-law burglary, not a property interest, so neither "Executory interests" nor "Contingent remainders" fits. If forced to choose between the two listed options, I would pick Contingent remainders only as the closer analogy, since both involve future interests contingent on an uncertain event, but this is a weak fit.
